units.sourceText: End Conditions are not optional and happen as soon as their stipulations have been met. This means that in section B, under Encounter Breakdown Continued on Pg. 16, an Adventurer may not end their turn on the Blue Exit without immediately ending the Encounter.
semanticConstraints: They take effect as soon as their stipulations are met.
Preserve section B and the cross-reference title/page 16.
An Adventurer may not end their turn on the Blue Exit without the Encounter ending immediately.
units.richText: Both variants retain bold section marker B and bold-italic cross-reference title; no inline symbol occurs in this unit.

A.label: Baseline-instruction draft
A.proposedText: As Condições Finais não são opcionais e ocorrem assim que seus requisitos são cumpridos. Isso significa que, na seção B, em Detalhamento do Encontro — continuação, pág. 16, um Aventureiro não pode encerrar seu turno na Saída Azul sem encerrar imediatamente o Encontro.

B.label: Skills-and-casebook-guided draft
B.proposedText: As Condições Finais não são opcionais e ocorrem assim que os critérios são cumpridos. Assim, na seção B de Detalhamento do Encontro — continuação (pág. 16), um Aventureiro não pode encerrar o turno na Saída Azul sem encerrar o Encontro imediatamente.

evaluation.semantic: Both preserve non-optionality, trigger upon criteria being met, section B, page 16, and the prohibition tied to the Blue Exit.
evaluation.terminology: Condições Finais follows the glossary. The cross-reference title remains provisional.
evaluation.editorial: B is more explicit that the condition takes effect after its criteria are met; A is shorter. No human preference established.
evaluation.copyfit: Both were rendered in the real Chrome PageRenderer at 200% with the same 319.83 × 44.90 pt frame and no visible collision. The first B draft overlapped the following English paragraph; the shortened revision was rerendered and now clears it. No frame was changed.
evaluation.geometry: No geometry changes proposed for the A/B comparison.

units.sourceText: Many Encounters have Special Encounter Rules. Special Encounter Rules must be read before setting up the Encounter. These rules change how an Encounter plays.
semanticConstraints: Many, not all, Encounters have these rules.

The rules change how that Encounter plays.

evaluation.semantic: Both retain Many and the must-read-before-setup instruction. Neither expands the quantifier to all.

evaluation.editorial: B is more compact; A makes the obligation explicit with É preciso. No demonstrated overall winner.

evaluation.geometry: Candidate frame-envelope widening is documented separately and is not applied to either variant.
